title: spec(ui): `page:header` `showStar` is declared but no longer reaches a user in the reference console: since objectui#12427 the star draws only where a host wires a favorites toggle, and no host does
body:
Filing gate: **declared ≠ enforced, routed to the enforce-or-remove channel.** It is a measured consequence of objectui#12427's last item (PR objectstack-ai/objectui#12465, option A as that card's contract review ruled). The fix, whichever way it goes, lands in `@objectstack/spec`.

- **Filed by:** objectui `domain:ui` seat 1 (seat post objectstack-ai/objectui#5560) · `session_01JZnppgHRp4sREcouhkQYDB`. ⛔ Not a claim; for triage to grade and route.
- `reach:` every author or AI who writes `showStar` on a `page:header` node. In the reference console it now has no visible effect either way.

## The declaration

`packages/spec/src/ui/component.zod.ts` (about `:735`–`:742`): `showStar: z.boolean().default(true)`, described as "Show the follow (favourite) star beside the record title. Part of the record chrome — no effect when `recordChrome` is false."

## What the renderer does after objectui#12427 (PR objectstack-ai/objectui#12465)

- `@object-ui/components`' `page:header` record chrome draws the star only when the record context carries `onToggleFavorite`. Before the change, a host with no toggle drew a star that flipped local state and stored nothing.
- The console's `RecordDetailView` no longer wires a toggle: the record's favorites entry moved to the header's `⋯` overflow, per objectui#12427's design. The PR's dev measured that no other in-tree host wires one: the metadata editor's page preview and plugin-detail's record binding do not.
- **So in the reference console:**
  - `showStar: true` (the default) draws nothing;
  - `showStar: false` hides nothing;
  - the key is inert.
  
  It stays live only for a third-party host of the published `@object-ui/components` that wires `onToggleFavorite`.
- **Producers:** a grep over objectui (apps, examples) and objectstack (examples, and package sources outside the spec's own schema, tests and migration template) finds none writing `showStar`.

## The question for the owner

Per the base principle, "a declared key the runtime does not honour is an implementation gap: build it or retire it":
- **Retire** `showStar` from `page:header`, through the ADR-0087 / D3 retirement route, if the platform's position is that the favorites control is the host's overflow entry. This is the zero-pull default.
- **Or** state in the describe that the star draws only where the host wires a favorites toggle, if a host-wired star is a supported capability.

Either way, the describe should stop promising a star the reference app never draws.

Dedupe: semantic search over objectstack issues for "page:header showStar favorite star record chrome no producer retire": 0 hits.
